pages.text: The Recall Focus allows the caster to teleport back to a location saved by the Focus. To use the Focus, it needs to have a location saved by right-clicking on either an $(l:crafts/artifice/arca)Arca$() owned by the Caster, a Bed, or a Respawn Anchor with it. Shift-right clicking the Focus will clear any saved location.
The spell also allows the caster to teleport their servant to the stored location, where they will stand by if they are able, by right-clicking on them.
